title: "1,234" + 1 is 1235: text with a thousands separator is read as a number

source.quote: the string is automatically converted into a corresponding number, as long as the string is a valid representation of a number
source.supports: the conversion needs a valid representation of a number; the page does not say whether "1,234" is one

source.quote: The value passed as the text parameter can be in any of the constant, number, date, or time formats recognized by the application or services you are using
source.supports: number formats are accepted broadly when text becomes a number

derivation: No source settles this. Reading "1,234" as a number in the en-US number format gives 1234, and 1234 + 1 = 1235.
alternative: "1,234" is not accepted as a number (only digits, a sign, a decimal point and an exponent are), and the query fails with a conversion error.
notes: The sources are silent on thousands separators. The column's type is not asserted.
